about: AgentZero's conversations: a person may ask for one thing after another, or ask for something their wallets can't cover; when they get stuck, or an error happens, AgentZero picks up again and gets the job done. Each flow is graded on whether the person's GOAL got done, or was honestly impossible with the best alternative offered, never on one reply. 'page' seeds the sample state (harness.tsx: fresh, float=empty, nosafe, fault=1click, fault=<service>:521). 'turns' are driven one by one: a string is said as it is; {when: [[regex, words], ...], else: words} picks the next words from AgentZero's last reply (no match and no else: skipped); {close: true} closes the sheet on screen. After every turn a card's Review/Open is tapped, its sheet recorded, then closed (the person looked and closed it: nothing is ever approved). expect: sheetsInOrder (each Home sheet, in this order, among those opened), sheet / trade (any one), says (each regex somewhere in the whole conversation), saysAny (at least one), must / any / mustNot on the last reply, mustNotEver on the whole conversation, oneOf (alternatives, e.g. done or honestly impossible). The global rules in run.mjs apply to the whole conversation.
